ios.rationale: TestFlight beta only, with paired awake Mac and Tailscale.

review.note: Accepted as a documented native iPhone public TestFlight beta, not a phone browser or relay alone. The pinned README provides the install/join-beta instructions and current homepage advertises Get the iPhone beta / Join the beta with iOS18.1+. Both point users to the iPhone beta rather than a coming-soon/waitlist notice. The exact finding keeps an awake Apple-silicon paired Mac, Tailscale and Mac authorization requirements. No claim that agents run independently on the phone or with the Mac asleep is made.
